ideas.pitch: An AI-powered satellite monitoring and change detection platform built for tracking illegal mining and environmental encroachment using Google Maps Platform and Vertex AI.
ideas.title: GeoSentinel India
ideas.why_it_could_win: Directly leverages multiple core Google technologies requested by the hackathon organizers (Google Maps Platform, Vertex AI) and follows the proven pattern of winning real-world compliance tools like GeoNex-ATLAS.

ideas.pitch: An automated data profiling and schema validation tool that connects directly to BigQuery, performs instant EDA using Gemini, and generates data integrity compliance reports.
ideas.title: QueryPulse BigQuery Insights
ideas.why_it_could_win: Combines BigQuery and Gemini to solve a heavy data engineering pain point, closely echoing the data-profiling and automated EDA approach that won DataVeritas an award.

ideas.pitch: An autonomous multi-agent diagnostic platform powered by Gemini and LangGraph that ingests IoT sensor feeds and citizen complaints via Firebase to prioritize urban infrastructure repairs.
ideas.title: CivicEye Autonomous Municipal Ops
ideas.why_it_could_win: Leverages cutting-edge multi-agent orchestration combined with Gemini and Firebase, replicating the exact technical architecture that secured 3rd prize at the SEAL Hackathon.

ideas.pitch: A video intelligence platform that transforms unstructured municipal and educational video archives into searchable, indexed knowledge bases using Vertex AI and Cloud Storage.
ideas.title: DocuStream AI Video Intelligence
ideas.why_it_could_win: Addresses unstructured data search and accessibility with heavy reliance on Google Cloud infrastructure, directly aligning with the LibrAI winning formula.

ideas.pitch: A secure web application featuring automated pre-deployment risk diagnosis for cloud infrastructure changes, orchestrated via Google OAuth and Gemini-driven security guardrails.
ideas.title: SecureGuard Identity & Access Dashboard
ideas.why_it_could_win: Focuses heavily on security and governance which are core stated themes of the TechRoom initiative ('secure, intelligent, scalable'), mimicking the successful agent-governance patterns seen in agent hackathons.
